posts.text:
Tying in this week's focus on the Reprobate Doctrine; these are trees without fruit. Genetic dead ends. They corrupt souls by grooming, recruiting and molesting children. We understand this. Many oppose it.

But few understand that this cycle of reprobation is the inversion of what we are called to do as Christians. That we are to win souls to Christ by the word of God, living as an example and offering relief from trauma, with compassion.

Too many Christians sit on the sidelines, happy in their state of being, and not wishing to engage others and be used by God to bring people to the truth of the Gospel.

A large measure of why we are here is because modern Christian sects are CINO. They may even claim to be evangelical, but do no soul winning. They might share innocuous and generic "God memes," and make Hillsong playlists on Spotify and think they are walking their best Christian walk.

Some ostensibly Christian parents won't "force" their faith on their own children, because they bought in to the Jewish lies about "letting them make up their own minds." Leaving their kids vunerable and exposed for these groomers to come in and fill their heads with perverse lies.

Salvation is an inoculation against this reprobate world, and you wouldn't fear the groomers' influence so much if you'd give your children the sure foundation of Christ to build on.

And, as Jesus overcame the world and in His righteousness allowed us to overcome, we can help others to similarly overcome sin, temptations, fear, etc.. by spreading that good news.

We have an advantage over the beast in that we can both reproduce naturally, after our kind, *and* recruit others into the fold.

**John 16:33**
 “*These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.”*

**Romans 12:21 **
"*Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good"*

**Matthew 28:19 **
"*Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost"*

**Luke 14:23**
"*And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled."*
